positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Contribute to development of both internal tools for customer service representatives and external website for millions of AAA members
- Develop features, bug fixes and advise on UI experience
- Languages/Tools: Visual Studio, C#, ASP.NET, SSMS, Javascript, CSS

positions.title: Mobile Software Developer
positions.description:
- Tackle user stories through pair programming
- Adapt existing web views for the mobile application view
- Bug fixes, UI changes, etc
- Languages/tools: Xcode, Swift, Obj-C, Android Studio, Java

positions.title: Mobile Software Developer
positions.description:
- Use knowledge of the travel space to design, test, and deliver an intuitive experience to millions of business users
- Developed and updated the iOS travel navigation experience including engaging animations
- Bug fixes and enhancements developed in Xcode
- Provide support and improvements to the continuous integration process used by all developers under Concur Mobile for a smooth release process

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Contributed toward a fully automated continuous integration process to decrease releases with bugs that may effect end-user experience
- Implemented bash scripts to run and test builds in conjunction with Xcode in order to increase effiency in the code check-in process and increase code quality by eliminating environmental dependencies for developer builds
- Authored documentation for processes created to standardize future implementations

positions.title: Chemist
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
-	Assist with process validation procedures
-	Perform evaluation of vendor samples according to established procedures. Assists with the evaluation of raw materials, in-process materials and finished reagents.
-	Project facilitator for revision/re-establishment of manufacturing documents and procedures
-	Follows established safety/environmental procedures and FDA regulations
-	Assists with customer complaint investigations, stability studies and expiration date extensions

volunteerExperiences.description: Work with high school students during a 10 week specialized course teaching Android mobile development.

projects.title: Capstone Project
projects.description: Given 4 weeks, the assignment was to explore an area of technology that excited us. I decided to explore mobile development and created a Android application that used Spotify API to create a Jukebox DJ in which multiple users could queue up music for a party to play from a single mobile phone.
